entities.summary: The government of Salvador Illa was formed on 12 August 2024 following the latter's election as President of the Government of Catalonia by the Parliament of Catalonia on 8 August and his swearing-in on 10 August, as a result of the Socialists' Party of Catalonia (PSC) being able to muster a majority of seats in the Parliament with external support from the Republican Left of Catalonia (ERC) and Commons Unite following the 2024 Catalan regional election. It succeeded the Aragonès government and has been the incumbent Government of Catalonia since 12 August 2024, a total of 597 days.
